meaning.en: Term used in project management to describe things that have actually happened rather than just planned to happen.

sentences.en: The actuals remain of importance but in these kinds of organizations they take an equal place alongside the budget.

sentences.en: This practice continuously compares budgeted amounts with actuals and as such is providing some measure of performance against a predetermined standard.
